description: This Java class 'AccrualAccountingDataValidator' is responsible for validating JSON input data related to accrual accounting, specifically for loan periodic accruals. It checks for required parameters, parses dates, and ensures that the 'accrue till' date is before the current date. The class utilizes helper utilities for JSON parsing and validation, and throws exceptions if the input data is invalid.

classes.name: AccrualAccountingDataValidator
classes.description: A component class that provides validation logic for accrual accounting JSON data for loans, including parameter validation and date checks.

methods.name: validateLoanPeriodicAccrualData
methods.description: Validates the input JSON for loan periodic accrual, ensuring required parameters are present and the 'accrue till' date is valid and before the current business date.

methods.name: throwExceptionIfValidationWarningsExist
methods.description: Throws a validation exception if there are any collected validation errors.
